name: Shoutmon X4B
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [Shoutmon X4] x [Beelzemon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
main_effect:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait from your hand or from under one of your Tamers under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Then, if [Beelzemon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 2 cards with the [Xros Heart] trait from your trash to your hand.
